Extensive Microsoft D365 Customer Service, Marketing & Sales Implementation experience and developing enhancements: Across life cycle with multiple geographies and work as a CRM solution consultant. Ability to work in high-paced and complex projects and understand industry-specific customer service processes, marketing and campaigning processes, operations and functional needs. Thorough skills to manage stakeholder expectations and be engaging in resolving issues and risks for the success of the project. Job Summary: The Statutory Compliance – Legal Team supports the organization in ensuring adherence to statutory, regulatory, and internal compliance requirements across India. The role is responsible for conducting compliance checks, maintaining governance documentation, monitoring risks, and supporting continuous improvements in compliance processes. This individual acts as a key link between internal teams and external stakeholders to ensure timely compliance, risk mitigation, and effective communication of statutory requirements. Roles & Responsibilities: Understanding the relevant statutory enactments, emphasis to labour laws and carry out the compliances Handle inspections, audits and ongoing compliance activities under various central and state enactments with the collaboration of internal and external stakeholders Carry out periodical filings under various labour law enactments and prepare registers & records. Interact with external consultants regularly for compliance required under applicable laws. Work on compliance management process and track compliance status across functions in co-ordination with Stakeholders Work closely and collaboratively with stakeholders such as Business, Legal, HR, Procurement, Controllership and Workplace to handle statutory and regulatory compliance related issues. Participate in the process improvement implementations Record management and coordinate with internal as well as cross functional teams. Maintain and update compliance calendar, trackers, periodical reports and repositories. Conduct risk assessments and analyze data to identify potential compliance issues. Develop and implement strategies to mitigate risks. Candidate should have good excel skills. Adaptable and flexible Strong understanding of compliance rules and procedures. Excellent analytical, organizational, and communication skills. Ability to work collaboratively with various teams and departments. Develop and implement strategies to mitigate risks. Coordinate with internal and external stakeholders to improve processes and remediate vulnerabilities. Conduct regular audits to ensure compliance with internal and external regulations. Prepare and present reports on compliance and risk management activities. Assist in the development and maintenance of the Compliance Management System. Job Qualification: Additional Information: - The ideal candidate should possess a strong educational background in Law or a related field, along with good knowledge and experience in relevant country compliance. - This position is based at our Bengaluru office. Grow your career and experience a stimulating, fast-paced environment working with prestigious clients on diverse projects to solve significant business challenges. The differentiating Capabilities of CFO&EV Practice combines the broad focus of CFO Strategy with agile planning, sustainable growth, data driven thinking and automation to drive value creation. Accenture CFO&EV Practice has expertise in delivering Shared Services Transformations, Target operating model definition, Zero Based Organization/Zero Based Spend Full Cycle, Intelligent Enterprise Platforms Transformation/Automation, Enterprise Performance Management Strategy implementation, F&PA Process Design and Blueprints, AI-Powered Planning & Forecasting, Digital Reporting & Analytics, Enabling Technologies, Tax Process Automation, Treasury Strategy, Working Capital Optimization, Risk Strategy and Assessment, Cyber Resilience and Security, Financial Crime & Regulatory Compliance, Data Driven Consulting, Client Value Analysis, SAP BPC and S/4 HANA green field and brown field transformations with 150+ projects per year. Must have skills : Microsoft ASP.NET Good to have skills : NA Minimum 5 year(s) of experience is required Educational Qualification : 15 years full time education Summary: As a Packaged/SaaS Application Engineer, a typical day involves configuring and supporting packaged or software as a service applications to tailor features according to evolving business requirements. The role includes managing software releases and ensuring the overall stability and performance of the systems. The engineer works with various tools, application programming interfaces, and low-code platforms to deliver solutions that align with organizational goals while maintaining compatibility across different environments. Collaboration with stakeholders to understand needs and adapt applications accordingly is a key part of daily activities. Roles & Responsibilities: - Expected to be an SME, collaborate and manage the team to perform. - Responsible for team decisions. - Engage with multiple teams and contribute on key decisions. - Provide solutions to problems for their immediate team and across multiple teams. - Lead efforts to optimize application configurations to improve user experience and system efficiency. - Coordinate cross-functional communication to ensure alignment on project goals and deliverables. - Mentor junior team members to support their professional growth and enhance team capabilities. Professional & Technical Skills: - Must To Have Skills: Proficiency in ASP.NET MVC. - Experience in developing and maintaining web applications using the Model-View-Controller architectural pattern. - Strong knowledge of application lifecycle management and release processes. - Familiarity with integrating third-party APIs and services to extend application functionality. - Ability to troubleshoot and resolve complex application issues to maintain system reliability. - Experience working with low-code platforms to accelerate development and customization. Additional Information: - The candidate should have minimum 5 years of experience in ASP.NET MVC. - This position is based at our Hyderabad office. - A 15 years full time education is required. 15 years full time education About Accenture Accenture is a leading global professional services company that helps the world’s leading businesses, governments and other organizations build their digital core, optimize their operations, accelerate revenue growth and enhance citizen services—creating tangible value at speed and scale. -Governance & Documentation -Maintain solution design documents, runbooks, and operational guides -Define IAM policies, standards, and best practices for the organization -Stakeholder Engagement -Collaborate with business owners, application teams, HR, and security to gather and translate requirements into IIQ configurations -Provide training and knowledge transfer to L1/L2 support teams -Act as the escalation point for complex IAM incidents and service requests Professional & Technical Skills: -Experience in IAM, with 5–7+ years hands-on SailPoint IIQ -IIQ Modules	LCM, Compliance Manager, You will be aligned with our Finance Operations vertical and will be helping us in determining financial outcomes by collecting operational data/reports, whilst conducting analysis and reconciling transactions.
Procure to Pay is the process of managing the entire purchasing cycle from ordering goods and services to making the final payment. It includes steps like requisitioning, purchasing, receiving, invoicing, and payment processing. The goal is to ensure efficient and accurate procurement and payment activities. This process helps in maintaining good supplier relationships and controlling costs. Effective Procure to Pay systems streamline operations and improve financial management. keyword includes:- ("Invoice Processing", "PO & Non PO","Vendor Payament","Master Data Managemet", "Vendor Management", "Accounts Payable")
Refers to the systematic handling and management of incoming invoices within a business or organization. It involves tasks such as verifying the accuracy of the invoice, matching it with purchase orders and delivery receipts, and initiating the payment process. | Accenture | Business Process Designer | India | Posted 2 Days Ago | onsite | internship | junior | Chennai | Consulting & IT Services | Project Role : Business Process Designer Project Role Description : Analyzes, develops, and improves workflows. Identifies inefficiencies in existing processes and proposes solutions to optimize effectiveness. Collaborates with business users to identify and define detailed product requirements and use cases. Design continuous monitoring and feedback collection to help them refine processes over time. Must have skills : Software Product Management Good to have skills : NA Minimum 12 year(s) of experience is required Educational Qualification : 15 years full time education Summary: The responsibilities of a Product Lead IT (PLIT) can vary from one product to another depending on the nature and setup of the product. However, there are many common factors. Each PLIT owns all the responsibilities associated with developing their product. Still, they need to collaborate with their counterparts on BU/FU side as well as the product team and delegate the workload according to the team needs. Together with their counterparts on BU/FU side, PLIT ensures that quality products are delivered on time and, most importantly, that the product creates value for our business. The PLIT role is empowered to make decisions about their product. Therefore, together with the Product Lead BU (if available), the PLIT is clarifying the product backlog items and deciding which items to do. They, PLIT and PLBU, must make all the decisions about the product by knowing the business needs and expectations. In addition to the significant delivery responsibilities, the PLIT is also expected to establish a strong network and relationships, not only internally within the team, but also with the broader customer, stakeholder, and management groups relevant to their product. The PLIT must have a clear understanding of the competition and future trends of the domain or product and the solutions being developed. Roles & Responsibilities: - In alignment and together with their counterpart on BU/FU side the PLIT: - Set the goals and create the product vision and documentation. - Are responsible for the implementation strategy: architecture, quality, sustainability, and maintainability. - Maintain the product backlog, managing requirements and tasks that need to be done by the team. - Prioritize the work according to the OKRs of the product to ensure the product vision is met. - Develop a release plan and product roadmap and ensure that everyone involved has a common understanding of the product development. - Are responsible for providing the best return on investment of their product and negotiating financial targets and expected key results for the product. - Are responsible for all economic and financial decision making during the development of a release and/or version of the product. - Are able and empowered to adjust time, scope, and quality according to the business needs or for needed technical developments within the approved budget. Cost and benefit should be a key factor to determine the order of the work. - Motivate the team and seek feedback. They coordinate all questions of the team and listen to suggestions about adding, deleting, changing, or improving the product. They represent the customer, user, and strategic stakeholders of the product to the team. - Have disciplinary responsibility for the Product Team IT members. - Define the objectives and key results needed to realize the vision of the product and to pay for the objectives of the product group. - Define suitable business KPIs to measure the benefit/value of the product. Together with the Product Lead BU they track and report financial KPIs to the product group level. - Keep an eye on all aspects of the product, the Minimum Viable Product (MVP), positive ROI results, and the time to market. - Have to find the right balance between necessary technical tasks (e.g., Security, Refactoring or Documentation) and feature developments. - Exchange with other PLITs and agree on common methods. As many products are dependent on other products, the PLIT is also constantly in alignment with other PLITs in terms of product vision, product strategy, and product roadmap. - Constantly monitor the market and observe what our competitors do in the IT field concerning the product. Must have skills : Software Product Management Good to have skills : NA Minimum 7.5 year(s) of experience is required Educational Qualification : 15 years full time education Summary: The responsibilities of a Product Lead IT (PLIT) can vary from one product to another depending on the nature and setup of the product. However, there are many common factors. Each PLIT owns all the responsibilities associated with developing their product. Still, they need to collaborate with their counterparts on BU/FU side as well as the product team and delegate the workload according to the team needs. Together with their counterparts on BU/FU side, PLIT ensures that quality products are delivered on time and, most importantly, that the product creates value for our business. The PLIT role is empowered to make decisions about their product. Therefore, together with the Product Lead BU (if available), the PLIT is clarifying the product backlog items and deciding which items to do. They, PLIT and PLBU, must make all the decisions about the product by knowing the business needs and expectations. In addition to the significant delivery responsibilities, the PLIT is also expected to establish a strong network and relationships, not only internally within the team, but also with the broader customer, stakeholder, and management groups relevant to their product. The PLIT must have a clear understanding of the competition and future trends of the domain or product and the solutions being developed. Roles & Responsibilities: - In alignment and together with their counterpart on BU/FU side the PLIT: - Set the goals and create the product vision and documentation. - Are responsible for the implementation strategy: architecture, quality, sustainability, and maintainability. - Maintain the product backlog, managing requirements and tasks that need to be done by the team. - Prioritize the work according to the OKRs of the product to ensure the product vision is met. - Develop a release plan and product roadmap and ensure that everyone involved has a common understanding of the product development. - Are responsible for providing the best return on investment of their product and negotiating financial targets and expected key results for the product. - Are responsible for all economic and financial decision making during the development of a release and/or version of the product. - Are able and empowered to adjust time, scope, and quality according to the business needs or for needed technical developments within the approved budget. Cost and benefit should be a key factor to determine the order of the work. - Motivate the team and seek feedback. They coordinate all questions of the team and listen to suggestions about adding, deleting, changing, or improving the product. They represent the customer, user, and strategic stakeholders of the product to the team. - Have disciplinary responsibility for the Product Team IT members. - Define the objectives and key results needed to realize the vision of the product and to pay for the objectives of the product group. - Define suitable business KPIs to measure the benefit/value of the product. Together with the Product Lead BU they track and report financial KPIs to the product group level. - Keep an eye on all aspects of the product, the Minimum Viable Product (MVP), positive ROI results, and the time to market. - Have to find the right balance between necessary technical tasks (e.g., Security, Refactoring or Documentation) and feature developments. - Exchange with other PLITs and agree on common methods. As many products are dependent on other products, the PLIT is also constantly in alignment with other PLITs in terms of product vision, product strategy, and product roadmap. - Constantly monitor the market and observe what our competitors do in the IT field concerning the product. The PLIT should look at products and be able to tell what is good, what is inspiring, and what can be improved. - InfoSec focus: Compliance with legal requirements and contractual customer specifications  identify, assess, and manage risks associated with the products, develop, and implement action plans for risk mitigation. Ensure compliance of the managed products with company policies (IMS and ISMS). They should be able to communicate the product vision, align people and stake holders, focus their efforts, and motivate the team. Their high emotional intelligence helps them collaborate and successfully shape product development. - Able to create products that delight customers. | Accenture | Program/Project Management Lead | India | Posted 2 Days Ago | onsite | internship | junior | Chennai | Consulting & IT Services | Project Role : Program/Project Management Lead Project Role Description : Manage overall delivery of a program or project to achieve business outcomes. Define project scope and monitor execution of deliverables. Communicate across multiple stakeholders to manage expectations, issues and outcomes. Must have skills : Software Product Management Good to have skills : NA Minimum 12 year(s) of experience is required Educational Qualification : 15 years full time education Summary: The responsibilities of a Product Lead IT (PLIT) can vary from one product to another depending on the nature and setup of the product. However, there are many common factors. Each PLIT owns all the responsibilities associated with developing their product. Still, they need to collaborate with their counterparts on BU/FU side as well as the product team and delegate the workload according to the team needs. Together with their counterparts on BU/FU side, PLIT ensures that quality products are delivered on time and, most importantly, that the product creates value for our business. The PLIT role is empowered to make decisions about their product. Therefore, together with the Product Lead BU (if available), the PLIT is clarifying the product backlog items and deciding which items to do. They, PLIT and PLBU, must make all the decisions about the product by knowing the business needs and expectations. In addition to the significant delivery responsibilities, the PLIT is also expected to establish a strong network and relationships, not only internally within the team, but also with the broader customer, stakeholder, and management groups relevant to their product. The PLIT must have a clear understanding of the competition and future trends of the domain or product and the solutions being developed. Roles & Responsibilities: - In alignment and together with their counterpart on BU/FU side the PLIT: - Set the goals and create the product vision and documentation. - Are responsible for the implementation strategy: architecture, quality, sustainability, and maintainability. - Maintain the product backlog, managing requirements and tasks that need to be done by the team. - Prioritize the work according to the OKRs of the product to ensure the product vision is met. - Develop a release plan and product roadmap and ensure that everyone involved has a common understanding of the product development. - Are responsible for providing the best return on investment of their product and negotiating financial targets and expected key results for the product. - Are responsible for all economic and financial decision making during the development of a release and/or version of the product. - Are able and empowered to adjust time, scope, and quality according to the business needs or for needed technical developments within the approved budget. Cost and benefit should be a key factor to determine the order of the work. - Motivate the team and seek feedback. They coordinate all questions of the team and listen to suggestions about adding, deleting, changing, or improving the product. They represent the customer, user, and strategic stakeholders of the product to the team. - Have disciplinary responsibility for the Product Team IT members. - Define the objectives and key results needed to realize the vision of the product and to pay for the objectives of the product group. - Define suitable business KPIs to measure the benefit/value of the product. Together with the Product Lead BU they track and report financial KPIs to the product group level. - Keep an eye on all aspects of the product, the Minimum Viable Product (MVP), positive ROI results, and the time to market. - Have to find the right balance between necessary technical tasks (e.g., Security, Refactoring or Documentation) and feature developments. - Exchange with other PLITs and agree on common methods. As many products are dependent on other products, the PLIT is also constantly in alignment with other PLITs in terms of product vision, product strategy, and product roadmap. - Constantly monitor the market and observe what our competitors do in the IT field concerning the product. The PLIT should look at products and be able to tell what is good, what is inspiring, and what can be improved. - InfoSec focus: Compliance with legal requirements and contractual customer specifications  identify, assess, and manage risks associated with the products, develop, and implement action plans for risk mitigation. Ensure compliance of the managed products with company policies (IMS and ISMS). Professional & Technical Skills: - Master's degree in computer science or a similar degree - Highly motivated and fully engaged in the development of the product. - Hands-on, result- and solution-oriented character - Understanding the target and customer needs. Strong business knowledge to lead the team and product development while coordinating with all the stakeholders. - Able to develop good relationships with internal customers and third-party suppliers. - Excellent communicator who can work collaboratively across many different roles and functions. They should be able to communicate the product vision, align people and stake holders, focus their efforts, and motivate the team. Their high emotional intelligence helps them collaborate and successfully shape product development. - Able to create products that delight customers. While it is important to listen to the stakeholders and change the back log accordingly, it is also important to listen to the customer and discover their needs.   Looking ahead about additional features and functionality that would be helpful. They always look at the broader picture. - Strong interpersonal and communication skills, with a high level of written and spoken English.
